336:t_005:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Hm... She'll be here in about 4 minutes.」

336:t_005:5.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$ストラウス$$, the $$欲深な金牛$$...!」

336:t_005:6.en:
$$五飛$$
「Why is the commander of all $$新地球皇国$$ forces here...!?」

336:t_005:7.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「What do we do, $$ゼロ$$?」

336:t_005:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...It's dangerous to take on a Reactor with our current forces.」

336:t_005:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Luckily, the townspeople and the lab staff have been evacuated. We'll fight all-out until $$ストラウス$$ arrives, then fall back!」

336:t_005:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Not so fast...! We'll dispose of you before the Supreme Commander arrives!」

336:t_005:11.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「And this facility, where there are those who defy the Empire, we'll burn to the ground, and...」

336:t_006:1.en:
???
「...I took a shot at you, but it seems I was a little off.」

336:t_006:3.en:
???
「Can't let an arsonist who sets fire to people's homes get away with it...!」

336:t_007:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone. $$クロウ・ブルースト$$, reporting in.」

336:t_007:2.en:
$n
「So that's the Reactor of the $$揺れる天秤$$, $$クロウ・ブルースト$$...!」

336:t_007:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
(That cool, aloof air is kind of dreamy...)

336:t_007:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, $$クロウ$$! We've finally been reunited!」

336:t_007:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Shut up, $$サルディアス$$. I've never once thought I wanted to see you again.」

336:t_007:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Is what I'd like to say, but that's not it. Seeing as I've got a debt to settle from $$翠の地球$$, I've been looking forward to this reunion.」

336:t_007:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... How dangerous this is.」

336:t_007:10.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Been waiting for you, our fearless leader!」

336:t_007:11.en:
$$桂$$
「This guy...! Showing up at a moment like this, he's trying way too hard to look cool!」

336:t_007:12.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Knowing him, he's probably up to his neck in debt again, as usual.」

336:t_007:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry to disappoint. I'm a clean man now, every last G paid back.」

336:t_007:16.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...While you all were fighting hard on $$蒼の地球$$, I was fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ on $$翠の地球$$.」

336:t_007:17.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You mean $$ランド$$ and $$セツコ$$ and the others?」

336:t_007:18.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah, that's right. After the $$時の牢獄$$ was destroyed, I sent the Chief the $$サイデリアル$$ data I got there.」

336:t_007:19.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Thanks to that, I paid off my 1,000,000 G in full. And as a bonus, they let me use the 《$$ＣＤＳ$$》 as much as I want for a while.」

336:t_007:24.en:
$$研究員$$
「I hear it was rough on $$翠の地球$$, $$クロウ$$. Forgive me for speaking over comms, but allow me to thank you for your efforts.」

336:t_007:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah. Considering the machine I had when I got teleported over there was the $$アクシオ・スコートＳＰ$$ and all.」

336:t_007:26.en:
$$研究員$$
「Getting back here must have been hard too, but I'll play the video message the Doctor prepared in case you came to the lab while she was away.」

336:t_008:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「Good work, $$クロウ$$. First off, I'm glad you made it back safe.」

336:t_008:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Heh... Awfully demure for the Chief.」

336:t_008:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ data you sent us was a big help. Let me thank you again.」

336:t_008:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's not like you. I just did my job faithfully.」

336:t_008:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「And while I'm at it...」

336:t_008:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「Your remaining debt is 1,000,000 G.」

336:t_009:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「W-w-w-what's going on!? When I sent the data, you said the debt was paid in full!」

336:t_009:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「I bet you're shocked, listening to this.」

336:t_009:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「But you see, sending you the upgraded $$リ・ブラスタ$$ across the dimensional wall cost a great deal.」

336:t_009:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「That total comes to 1,000,000 G.」

336:t_009:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Hold on! Isn't that a necessary expense!?」

336:t_009:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「I can picture you desperately making excuses.」

336:t_009:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well... if you have a complaint, take it up with yourself for getting the $$スコートＳＰ$$ shot down.」

336:t_009:7.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well then... I look forward to the day we meet again.」

336:t_010:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Ha, ha ha... No way... This can't be...」

336:t_010:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Straight back to a life of debt as soon as I'm home on $$蒼の地球$$!」

336:t_011:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$揺れる天秤$$! Don't talk about money on the battlefield!」

336:t_011:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Battle is the supreme game, where you stake all your knowledge and ability and set your own soul and body ablaze! And you, of all men, with your vulgar talk of money...!」

336:t_011:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Quit forcing your way of doing things on me.」

336:t_012:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...The 1,000,000 G man... Looks like that phrase suits me after all.」

336:t_012:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「All right, if that's how it is, I'll do it! Bring on arrows, bullets, debts, whatever you've got, damn it!!」

336:t_012:2.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Aw man... He's gone and gotten desperate...」

336:t_012:3.en:
$n
「I'd heard the $$揺れる天秤$$ activates the $$スフィア$$ with a strong will...」

336:t_012:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So that means... it's to pay off his debt...?」

336:t_013:0.en:
$$桂$$
「I feel for you, the way you live.」

336:t_013:2.en:
$$桂$$
「Today I'll back you up in place of $$デュオ$$ and $$ロックオン$$.」

336:t_014:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Work hard, $$クロウ$$! The road to 1,000,000 G is long!」

336:t_014:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Heh... I'm a veteran. I know that without being told.」

336:t_014:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So what... You mean that guy's taken on a 1,000,000 G debt again and again!?」

336:t_014:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「Paying it off over and over, then taking on more debt... I can't tell if that's amazing or not...」

336:t_014:5.en:
$n
「Even after a defeat, he rises again with unyielding fighting spirit...」

336:t_014:8.en:
$n
「Let's do it, $$クロウ$$! I'll fight too!」

336:t_014:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Thanks, $$いがみ合う双子$$. But from today on, we're comrades.」

336:t_014:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Just call me $$クロウ$$. And I'll call you $n from now on.」

スコートＳＰ.evidence: bare form of アクシオ・スコートＳＰ (Axio Scott SP) in brief 336:t_009:6
